title: Repository-wide dead-code cleanup and source-surface reduction
changes: Removed all 27 source modules previously classified as offline/dormant model-library code because they were neither loaded by index.html nor imported by the current script toolchain.
Restricted src/ to runtime modules plus the single CI generator module.
Strengthened source-module audit so dormant/offline source roles are no longer allowed.
Removed the obsolete time-based rotating-shard collector implementation and configuration after persistent cursor selection became canonical.
Removed dead collector configuration and an unused Node import.
Reduced exported helper surface in script libraries so purely internal helpers are no longer public APIs.
Updated collector tests to exercise behavior through supported public APIs rather than internal ordering helpers.
Audited index.html and found no unreferenced named function declarations or named arrow helpers.
guarantees: All 24 browser runtime source modules remain loaded and referenced by index.html.
playerDerivation.js remains the only non-runtime src module and is retained for CI reproducibility.
No canonical EV, market records, odds, checklists, team metadata or user-facing analysis semantics are intentionally changed by this cleanup.
Collector queue behavior remains persistent-cursor and team/player breadth-aware.
Future dormant src modules fail source-module inventory validation.
